rv.q: ''Say Goodnight Gracie'' is as toothless as a 100-year-old man, but to carp about it is pointless, like punching a marshmallow or criticizing a bedtime story.
All you need to know about the level of sophistication of 'Say Goodnight Gracie' is that it begins with George Burns talking to God.

cn.t: Critics find this one-man George Burns tribute disappointingly unsophisticated, with a childish framing device that undermines the material. The show receives a lukewarm-to-negative reception for its simplistic approach.
